summary: Clearwater County Aermotor ladder tower (Tower 68) erected 1931 in Mississippi Headwaters State Forest; county leases it for communications; FFLA lists standing.

facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service, now Minnesota DNR Forestry Division

access.note: Clearwater County leases the tower for communications (county list, undated). No public access information found.

visit.trail_note: No public access information found; the county leases the tower for communications, so treat it as off limits.

events.note: Erected in 1931 as Fire Tower 68. The Central US lookouts list and the Clearwater County text give an 80-foot Aermotor ladder tower; the county table gives 81 feet.
1941 survey notes describe the tower as about 100 feet high, of steel construction, with an enclosed crow's nest. This conflicts with the 80-foot figure.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 80 ft (Central US lookouts and the county text), 81 ft (county table) and about 100 ft (1941 survey note) all appear in the sources. The record keeps 24.4 m (80 ft). The other figures are not reconciled.
